issues.on_page: Other 11,867 (Materials and services sold and refunds)
issues.issue: The Statement of Activities counts this line in Charges for Services: Policy/administration charges 26,259 = public power lease 13,482 + licenses 910 + Other 11,867. It could be charges for services/fees rather than other. Detail[8] has the same question.

The budget-schedule receipt lines are fund totals that include interest income of 243 and 216 (p6), yet they are categorized wholly as Utility Charges. Exhibit H (p6) prints the utility collections and interest separately. The same applies to detail[30].
